dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します!
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to our session!

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: 「リクエスト希望あれば遠慮なく言ってくださいね」
dialogue.English: "If you have any requests, please don't hesitate to let me know."

dialogue.content: お気遣いありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your thoughtfulness.

dialogue.content: 特にないでしょうか？大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular? Are you sure?

dialogue.content: そうですね!お任せしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Let's see! Would it be alright if I leave it up to you?

dialogue.content: はいでは宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, then I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: The pleasure is all mine, I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はどのようなお悩みで相談にこられましたか？
dialogue.English: Good morning. What sort of concerns have brought you here today?

dialogue.content: 妻が全く家事をしないことで相談にきました
dialogue.English: I've come to talk about how my wife doesn't do any housework at all.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねかしこまりました
dialogue.English: I see. Understood.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつ頃から悩まれていますか？
dialogue.English: How long has this been bothering you?

dialogue.content: もう一年以上ですね
dialogue.English: For over a year now.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。長い間悩まれているんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been struggling with this for a long time.

dialogue.content: 奥さんが家事をやらないことについてどのように思われていますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your wife not doing the housework?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 娘が一人いて子供ができてからは付きっきりなので多少しょうがないかなとも思ってはいるのですが
dialogue.English: Well, we have one daughter, and since she was born, my wife has been completely focused on her, so I feel like it can't be helped to some extent.

dialogue.content: 娘さんができてから、家事をやらないようになってきたのですね
dialogue.English: So, she started not doing the housework after your daughter was born.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しょうがないという感情以外に何か思われていたりしますか？
dialogue.English: Besides feeling that it can't be helped, are there any other feelings you have?

dialogue.content: そうですね私も仕事をしているのでできたらもっと協力的だといいなとおもうことはあります
dialogue.English: Well, since I work too, there are times when I wish she would be more cooperative.

dialogue.content: しょうがないと思いつつも、そう思うのも無理はないですよね。
dialogue.English: Even though you feel it can’t be helped, it’s understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 娘さんが産まれた後の家事の割合はだいたいどれぐらいですか？
dialogue.English: Roughly what has the division of housework been like since your daughter was born?

dialogue.content: 生まれてからは手伝うよといってたので産後もあってほとんど私がしてましたそこからですね
dialogue.English: She said she would help after the birth, but with the postpartum period and everything, I've been doing almost all of it. It started from there.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。仕事をやりつつ、家事もほとんどやるのは大変な事ですよね
dialogue.English: I see. Balancing work and doing most of the housework must be really tough.

dialogue.content: 毎日、お疲れさまです
dialogue.English: You must be exhausted every day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥さんにはどれぐらい家事をやってもらえたらなというのはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a certain amount of housework you wish your wife would do?

dialogue.content: そうですね洗濯は合間に回すだけでもしてもらえたらとおもいます
dialogue.English: Well, I think it would be great if she could at least run the washing machine in her spare time.

dialogue.content: なるほど。たくさんやらなくてもいいけど、できる事はやって欲しいという感じですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. So it's not that she has to do a lot, but you'd like her to do what she can, is that right?

dialogue.content: 言い出したら全部ってなるので
dialogue.English: Because if I start to say something, it might turn into expecting everything.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥さんにお願いした時、奥さんは何とおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: When you've asked your wife for help, what does she say?

dialogue.content: その場ではできるときはって言いますけどその時だけなので
dialogue.English: At that moment, she'll say she'll do it when she can, but it's only for that moment.

dialogue.content: 口だけで行動には移してくれないのですね。
dialogue.English: So she says she will, but doesn't follow through with action.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それは不満に思いますよね
dialogue.English: That would be frustrating, wouldn’t it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。子育ても大変だけど、仕事も同じぐらい大変ですからね
dialogue.English: I understand. Raising a child is demanding, but work is just as demanding.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 色々とお話を聞かせて頂きましたが、結局は奥さんに家事をやってもらうにはどうしたらいいかを悩まれている感じですかね？
dialogue.English: From what you have shared, it sounds like you are ultimately struggling with how to get your wife to do the housework. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥さんはなぜ、家事をやってくれないのでしょうね？
dialogue.English: I wonder why your wife doesn't do the housework.

dialogue.content: それを知りたくて来たんですが
dialogue.English: That's what I came here to find out.

dialogue.content: 子育てが忙しいからという理由だけなのか、他の理由があるのか
dialogue.English: Is it only because she's busy with childcare, or might there be another reason...

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: ちょっと呼ばれたので退席しますねありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I've been called away, so I'll have to leave. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 急用が入った感じでしょうか？一応、11時までですが
dialogue.English: Did something urgent come up? Just so you know, our session is until 11:00.
